description: This Java class defines a REST API resource for configuring business steps within a job processing system. It includes endpoints to list jobs, retrieve and update their step configurations, and fetch available steps.

classes.name: ConfigureBusinessStepApiResource
classes.description: REST API resource for managing business step configurations, handling HTTP requests related to jobs and their steps.

methods.name: retrieveAllConfiguredBusinessJobs
methods.description: Handles GET /v1/jobs/names, returns list of configured business jobs.

methods.name: retrieveAllConfiguredBusinessStep
methods.description: Handles GET /v1/jobs/{jobName}/steps, returns configuration data for business steps of a specific job.

methods.name: updateJobBusinessStepConfig
methods.description: Handles PUT /v1/jobs/{jobName}/steps, updates the execution order of business steps for a specific job.

methods.name: retrieveAllAvailableBusinessStep
methods.description: Handles GET /v1/jobs/{jobName}/available-steps, returns list of available business steps for a given job.
